title: Network Simulation Foundation — Topology & Configuration Model v1.0.0
description: TASK-04 versioned logical data model. A ProjectStateDocument is the canonical serialization of the committed topology/configuration aggregate at one project state_revision. It contains persisted and persisted-derived data only; runtime simulation state and read-model projections are separate definitions. API envelopes are owned by TASK-07; simulation evidence is owned by TASK-05.

SchemaVersion.description: Model version of this document. Independent of application version and of project.state_revision.

Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDv7. Opaque, immutable, never reused.

Ipv4Address.description: Canonical dotted decimal, four decimal octets, no leading zeros.

DisplayName.description: User-visible name after Unicode White_Space trim and NFC normalization. Empty post-trim names are rejected by TASK-02.

NormalizedName.description: Persisted-derived uniqueness key: NFC(trim(display_name)) then Unicode full case folding. Never user-settable.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision and a literal Z suffix.

DeviceKind.description: Supported V1 device kinds (TASK-01 capability matrix). No device kind may be added without change control.

InterfaceKind.description: Nominal media kind. Derives nominal_speed_mbps (100 / 1000) and the transmission-delay class.

MdiClass.description: Derived from device kind: L2_SWITCH is MDI_X; PC, SERVER and ROUTER are MDI.

AdminState.description: Administrative interface state. Initial value ENABLED for every provisioned interface.

CableType.description: Physical cable class validated against the NET-03 matrix before a connection may be committed.

ChangeKind.description: Audit classification of a committed revision. Model-level bookkeeping; it does not add or alter network behavior.

ChangeClass.description: Classification of a commit. TOPOLOGY and CONFIGURATION change simulation-relevant state; PRESENTATION (placement) and METADATA (project text, device rename) do not. MIXED contains at least one simulation-relevant kind.

Position.description: Presentation-only placement in the 3D scene. Never affects simulation behavior (T1-05: MAC and configuration do not change on device movement).

Ipv4Configuration.description: Address/mask pair configured on one interface. Present means configured; absent means no IPv4 address. Cleared as a pair (T1-CFG-03).

prefix_length.description: Host interface prefixes are /1../30 only (T2-VAL-01..27). /0, /31 and /32 are structurally invalid on host interfaces.

state_revision.description: Monotonic committed-state revision of this project. Project creation commits revision 1. Increments by exactly one per committed mutation of the aggregate; never by Save or no-op writes.

simulation_revision.description: Highest state_revision whose change_class is TOPOLOGY, CONFIGURATION or MIXED. Unchanged by PRESENTATION and METADATA commits. This is the value evidence freshness is compared against.

device_sequence.description: Immutable creation order within the project. Provides deterministic device enumeration for UI and for stable interface identity ordering.

default_gateway_ipv4.description: Optional host default gateway. Permitted on PC and SERVER only; routers use static routes. May be stored while the host has no IPv4 address, in which case it is inactive (T1-CFG-04/05, VAL-B04).

next_route_sequence.description: Router-only allocation counter for immutable static-route creation order.

display_name.description: Fixed inventory port name. Unique within its device and not renamable in V1 (T1-FINAL-01).

ordinal.description: Immutable 0-based position in the device inventory. Combined with device_sequence it forms the stable interface identity used for deterministic connected-route tie-breaks (T3-DEC-07).

mac_address.description: Persisted, project-unique, locally administered unicast MAC. Assigned exactly once at interface provisioning and never changed by movement, configuration, Save or reopen (T1-05).

mac_sequence.description: Immutable 24-bit allocation sequence within the project. Together with project_id it reproduces mac_address; stored so MACs survive loss of the computed value without reassignment.

ipv4.description: Absent at creation (T1-GAP-01). Never present on an L2_SWITCH interface: V1 exposes no switch management IP.

interface_a_id.description: Canonical first endpoint: the lexicographically smaller interface_id of the unordered pair.

interface_b_id.description: Canonical second endpoint: the lexicographically larger interface_id.

connection_sequence.description: Immutable creation order within the project. Deterministic enumeration only; never used for routing tie-breaks.

destination_network.description: Canonical destination network: every host bit beyond prefix_length is zero (T2-VAL-26).

prefix_length.description: Static-route prefixes are /0../32. /0 with 0.0.0.0 is the only default-route form.

next_hop_ipv4.description: Next-hop address. Eligibility (direct connected reachability, non-recursive, not a local router address) is determined at simulation time, not at configuration time (T3-DEC-04/09).

route_sequence.description: Immutable creation order within the router. Preserved across edits and deletion of other routes; the tie-break for equivalent static candidates (T3-DEC-10).

ProjectRevision.description: Append-only audit record, one per committed revision. Written in the same transaction as the mutation it describes.

affected_entity_ids.description: Identities touched by the commit. Diagnostic aid; not authoritative configuration.

Checkpoint.description: Save marker. Records the revision that was current at Save time; it does not copy or advance state (T2 3.2). Lifecycle and retention are TASK-06.

SimulationSnapshotRef.description: Immutable simulation snapshot identity. TASK-04 owns identity and digest; TASK-05 owns the results and evidence produced from it.

base_state_revision.description: Project state_revision whose configuration the snapshot captures.

base_simulation_revision.description: Project simulation_revision at capture time. Evidence is current only while this equals the project's current simulation_revision.

configuration_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical configuration projection defined in TASK-04 section 7.4. Presentation, timestamps and audit records are excluded.

DerivedInterfaceState.description: Non-persisted read-model projection. MUST NOT be written back as configuration.

DerivedWarning.description: Derived warning attached to committed state. Code spelling and serialization are TASK-05; this definition fixes only the structural shape and provenance, never a new warning category.

code.description: Stable warning code owned by TASK-05.

derivation.description: Approved TASK-02 warning source. At most one derivation per warning instance.

DerivedProjection.description: Optional computed view over committed state. Recomputable at any time; never persisted, never an input to a mutation.
